versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.1.0 · 原生工程与连接验证 / Native foundation and connection probes
versions.summaryZh: 原生 Kotlin/Compose 工程、SQL Server/MySQL 驱动探针、TLS 与错误分类。 建立固定工具链、CI 和不可覆盖归档；尚无完整数据库工作台。
versions.summaryEn: Native Kotlin/Compose application, SQL Server/MySQL driver probes, TLS and classified errors. Introduced a pinned toolchain, CI and immutable archives; a complete database workbench was not yet available.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.2.0 · SQL Server 工作台 / SQL Server workbench
versions.summaryZh: 数据库、Schema、表结构浏览，主键分页和 SELECT 查询。 新增单行增改删预览、参数绑定、事务和并发检查。
versions.summaryEn: Database, schema and table browsing, primary-key pagination and SELECT queries. Added single-row create/update/delete previews, parameter binding, transactions and conflict detection.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.2.1 · 会话一致性与 TLS 兼容 / Session consistency and TLS compatibility
versions.summaryZh: 修复切库失败后的界面状态与会话状态不一致。 加入 Conscrypt engine socket，补充取消、超时与关闭验证。
versions.summaryEn: Fixed UI/session disagreement after a failed database switch. Added Conscrypt engine sockets and additional cancellation, timeout and close checks.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.2.2 · 驱动源码适配 / Driver source adaptation
versions.summaryZh: 建立可重放的 SQL Server Android 派生驱动构建。 修复缓冲参数溢出，调整证书与 SQLXML 路径；R8 仍未通过。
versions.summaryEn: Introduced a reproducible SQL Server Android driver patch build. Fixed buffer-size overflow and adapted certificate and SQLXML paths; R8 remained blocked.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.3.0 · 关系型多数据库工作台 / Multi-database SQL workbench
versions.summaryZh: 新增 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL 对象浏览与只读查询。 新增 SQLite 文件私有副本浏览，修复类型精度和连接配置迁移。
versions.summaryEn: Added MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL browsing and read-only queries. Added SQLite private-copy browsing, numeric fidelity fixes and connection-format migration.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.4.0 · 键值数据库与移动工作流 / Key-value databases and mobile workflow
versions.summaryZh: 新增 Redis/Valkey 的 SCAN、类型、TTL 与六类键预览。 优化连接卡片，加入 SQL 收藏和当前页 CSV 导出。
versions.summaryEn: Added Redis/Valkey SCAN, types, TTL and previews for six key types. Improved connection cards and added SQL favorites and current-page CSV export.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.5.0 · MongoDB 文档工作台 / MongoDB document workbench
versions.summaryZh: 新增 TLS/SCRAM 登录、集合、受限 JSON 筛选和游标分页。 保留 Extended JSON 类型，修复 Android SASL 兼容问题。
versions.summaryEn: Added TLS/SCRAM authentication, collections, bounded JSON filters and cursor pagination. Preserved Extended JSON types and resolved Android SASL compatibility.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.6.0 · 搜索引擎工作台 / Search-engine workbench
versions.summaryZh: 新增 Elasticsearch/OpenSearch 索引、映射、受限 DSL 与分页。 保留 JSON 数字原文，明确区分不完整响应与完整结果。
versions.summaryEn: Added Elasticsearch/OpenSearch indices, mappings, bounded DSL and pagination. Preserved JSON numeric text and distinguished incomplete responses from complete results.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.7.0 · 连接服务器后扫描数据库 / Discover databases before connecting
versions.summaryZh: 先扫描当前账号可见目标，再筛选选择数据库或索引。 按引擎处理入口库、逻辑库和扫描取消，保留手动填写。
versions.summaryEn: Discover targets visible to the current account, then filter and select a database or index. Handled engine-specific entry databases, logical databases and cancellation, with manual entry retained.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.7.1 · 证书预览与指纹信任 / Certificate preview and fingerprint trust
versions.summaryZh: 新增服务器证书预览及连接专属 SHA-256 指纹确认。 改善 IP/自签名证书连接流程，不静默信任所有证书或降级明文。
versions.summaryEn: Added server-certificate preview and connection-specific SHA-256 fingerprint confirmation. Improved IP/self-signed certificate workflows without silently trusting all certificates or falling back to plaintext.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.7.2 · 连接页面优化 / Connection-page refinement
versions.summaryZh: 使用数据库类型分类卡片与更清晰的连接参数布局。 证书入口更明显，扫描结果使用单选列表。
versions.summaryEn: Introduced categorized database cards and clearer connection fields. Made certificate controls easier to find and introduced single-selection discovery results.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.8.0 · 密码保存与表格编辑 / Saved passwords and spreadsheet editing
versions.summaryZh: 可选本机加密保存密码；SQL 表格增加选中、复制和双击编辑。 加入 SQL Tab 补全、主题、表格密度与持久化设置。
versions.summaryEn: Added optional locally encrypted passwords and SQL-grid selection, copying and double-tap editing. Added SQL Tab completion, themes, grid density and persistent settings.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.8.1 · 表收藏与快捷连接 / Table favorites and quick connections
versions.summaryZh: 修复连接后对象列表加载，加入表收藏和历史连接快捷入口。 改进跨库收藏定位和连接清理，保持证书与密码绑定。
versions.summaryEn: Fixed object loading after connection and added table favorites and recent-connection shortcuts. Improved cross-database favorite navigation and connection cleanup while retaining certificate and password binding.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.9.0 · AI 助手与宽表浏览 / AI assistant and wide-table browsing
versions.summaryZh: 新增三类 AI 文本协议、国内外服务预设、模型获取和 SQL 草稿。 宽表分组读取、全屏、列显隐、列宽和整行详情。
versions.summaryEn: Added three AI text protocols, international and Chinese provider presets, model discovery and SQL drafts. Added column-window loading for wide tables, fullscreen grids, column visibility/width and row details.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.9.1 · 日期读取修复与独立 AI 设置 / Date-reading fix and dedicated AI settings
versions.summaryZh: 修复 SQL Server 日期字段在 Android 上读取失败并断连。 AI 配置移到设置；字段属性支持搜索和主键筛选。
versions.summaryEn: Fixed SQL Server date-field reads failing and disconnecting on Android. Moved AI configuration into Settings and added searchable field properties and primary-key filtering.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.10.0 · 工作台布局与缩放 / Workbench layout and zoom
versions.summaryZh: 固定数据、SQL 编辑器、表结构页签；数据库使用搜索选择框。 加入双指缩放、日期字段编辑、WHERE/Tab 提示和可选实时 AI 建议。
versions.summaryEn: Introduced Data, SQL Editor and Structure tabs and searchable database selection. Added pinch zoom, date-field editing, WHERE/Tab suggestions and optional live AI suggestions.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.11.0 · 列头筛选排序与 AI 表操作 / Column filters, sorting and AI table actions
versions.summaryZh: 列头筛选、多列排序与数据库端分页，修复缩放文字裁切。 AI 可查询当前表并提出 SQL Server 单条变更预览，确认后提交。
versions.summaryEn: Added column filters, multi-column sorting and server-side pagination, and fixed clipped zoomed text. AI can query the current table and propose a single SQL Server row change for confirmation.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.12.0 · 工作状态恢复与表格维护 / Workspace restoration and table maintenance
versions.summaryZh: 改进错误后结果保留、重连恢复、筛选回填与类型处理。 全屏共享维护工具栏；加入单元格快捷筛选、列设置和查询历史。
versions.summaryEn: Improved retained results after errors, reconnect restoration, filter editing and type handling. Shared editing controls with fullscreen grids and added cell-based filters, column preferences and query history.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.12.1 · 浮点编辑与连续对话 / Floating-point editing and conversation
versions.summaryZh: 修复 SQL Server float/real 表编辑与并发比较，显示具体只读原因。 AI 新增直接聊天和内存中的多轮追问；本版尚无持久化对话。
versions.summaryEn: Fixed SQL Server float/real editing and conflict comparisons, with specific read-only reasons. Added direct AI chat and in-memory follow-up conversations; persistence was not yet available.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.12.2 · 大文本声明不再锁住整表 / Large text declarations no longer lock the table
versions.summaryZh: 修复 nvarchar(max)、varchar(max) 等声明导致整表只读。 完整加载的短值/NULL 可安全编辑；真正超限行仍受保护。
versions.summaryEn: Fixed nvarchar(max), varchar(max) and similar declarations making the whole table read-only. Fully loaded short values and NULLs can be edited safely; genuinely incomplete rows remain protected.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.13.0 · AI 记忆与多数据库编辑 / AI memory and multi-database editing
versions.summaryZh: 模型获取无需先保存；两个 AI 问答工作区、本机加密上下文记忆与直接双击编辑。 补充十种已接入引擎的受限单对象写入；SQL Server 整表删除另行确认。
versions.summaryEn: Model discovery without a separate save step, two conversational AI workspaces, encrypted local context memory and direct double-tap editing. Expanded guarded single-object writes across the ten implemented engines; SQL Server table deletion requires separate confirmation.

versions.title: 数舟 DataSail V0.14.0 · 正式签名与混淆发行 / Signed and minified Release
versions.summaryZh: 首次使用正式证书发布不可调试、R8 混淆和资源收缩安装包；修复多个数据库驱动的 Android 与反射兼容性。完整源码、测试证据、签名指纹与校验值随包公开。
versions.summaryEn: First production-signed, non-debuggable APK with R8 minification and resource shrinking. Fixes Android and reflection compatibility in multiple drivers and publishes complete source, evidence, certificate identity and checksums.
